questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests hands-on SAP HANA DR in AWS, cross-region data consistency, and IAM-based access controls.

## Key Concepts
- SAP HANA System Replication (SDR)
- Route 53 failover and health checks
- Cross-region backups to S3 with KMS
- Just-in-Time operator access (STS roles)
- Minimal CloudFormation for DR role and failover trigger

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation to create DR role and Lambda trigger
Resources:
  DRRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
          Action: [ sts:AssumeRole ]
      Path: /
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: DRInlinePolicy
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: 2012-10-17
          Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: [ ec2:DescribeInstances, route53:*, s3:*, logs:* ]
            Resource: "*"
  FailoverLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
            pass
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.9
      Role: !GetAtt DRRole.Arn
```

- How would you test DR failover without impacting production?
- How do you detect and resolve split-brain in SDR?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests real-world DR planning for SAP on AWS, including cross-region orchestration, recovery testing, and automation with IAM roles.

## Key Concepts
- Route 53 failover routing and health checks
- AWS Backup for SAP HANA volumes
- SSM Automation for repeatable DR runs
- SAP HANA cockpit checks for data consistency

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  Route53FailoverRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      Type: A
      Name: dr.example.com.
      Failover: SECONDARY
      HealthCheckId: !Ref DRHealthCheck
      SetIdentifier: DR
      TTL: 60
  Route53PrimaryRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      Type: A
      Name: prod.example.com.
      Failover: PRIMARY
      HealthCheckId: !Ref ProdHealthCheck
      SetIdentifier: PROD
  SAPAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ['ssm:SendCommand','ssm:DescribeAssociation','ssm:ListCommands']
                Resource: '*'
```

Resources:
